title: Kiosk
sayOrderHelp: Speak or type — the microphone is on the field, and it listens on this device.
orderPlaceholder: a large latte with oat milk
micIdleHint: Tap the microphone to speak, or just type.

noOrdersBody: Say or type an order and confirm it. Orders are per account: the list is scoped in SQL, not filtered in the template.
resetHint: Clear the current order and start again
